svg.title: Reminders, heads-ups and promises
svg.desc: An invoice that is not yet due gets a heads-up. A late invoice gets a gentle, firm or final reminder chosen from the days late, the reminders already sent and the client's history. A promised date pauses drafting until that date, and a broken promise makes the next reminder firm. Gemini writes a draft from facts only, with no contact details. Code checks the draft and falls back to a template in the client's language when the draft fails. The freelancer reviews it and sends either PayPal's own reminder or their own message. The reminder is logged once and the card closes for the day.
svg.text: The tone comes from facts. The freelancer sends. Nothing goes out by itself.
Not yet due: due today or soon.
Late, under 8 days, no reminder yet.
8 days late, one reminder sent, a
late payer or a broken promise.
Sign-off added by code, not the model

g.text: An invoice nearing its due date gets a heads-up, never a late notice
A late invoice gets gentle, firm or final from its facts and history
A promised date pauses drafting until that date
Gemini writes a draft from facts only. No contact details reach it
Code checks it. A draft that fails becomes a template
The draft opens for review. The freelancer may edit it
The freelancer sends PayPal's reminder or their own message
The send is logged once and the card closes for the day
